Fall is here. Winter is coming. The weather has just started to get chilly here, so I've started to look into affordable and practical solutions to stay warm and dry on the bike.

The way I see it, the challenges are as follows:

  • Wind chill. In cold weather, moving on the bike becomes even colder due to the increase in cold air flowing over the body. This makes clothing with wind resistance important. I find it especially important to have this feature on my gloves.
  • Air moisture. Cold weather often brings fog in the mornings and at night. This can cause moisture to accumulate on you while you ride. This makes water resistance important even when it isn't raining.
  • Rain. Keeping your body, and especially your neck, shoulders, and head dry in a downpour is crucial.
  • Sweat. If the above issues weren't bad enough, here comes the most bitter complication. All your efforts to keep warm and dry will often lead to you sweating profusely if you should need to tackle a steep hill or maintain a relatively high effort for any period of time.

And that's just on your body. The bike needs to be prepared too. Things like full fenders and chain lube designed for wet weather are the bare minimum requirement. Then there's things like special brake pads, tires, and a bit of extra maintenance each time you come home.

So. What do you do for winter riding? Any advice you'd like to share? Any gear you'd recommend? I'm still looking at options. I might get a balaclava. A decent jacket that will keep me warm and won't cook me on a climb would be nice too, but you can't have everything.

From what little I know about space warfare, height doesn't matter as much as position. The idea in 2d warefare (earth) is to prevent getting hit from the side or back. Being higher up immediately provides an advantage because you move in a 3rd dimension, which can't be matched easily. In space, it can, so the advantage is irrelevant. The true advantage lies in forming a complete sphere around your enemy, meaning they cannot attack you from the side or from behind.
